titulo.alumno:
«Экологическая политика и выбор»
Environmental policy and choices

intro: An environmental proposal usually balances expected benefit, cost, timing and effects on different groups; identify who gains and who bears the cost.

piezas.titulo: An environmental proposal usually balances expected benefit, cost, timing and effects on different groups; identify who gains and who bears the cost.
texto: An environmental proposal usually balances expected benefit, cost, timing and effects on different groups; identify who gains and who bears the cost.
Distinguish the declared aim from the measured result: планируется сократить does not claim that the reduction has already happened.

frases.estudio: Программа предусматривает сокращение выбросов к 2035 году.
frases.alumno: The programme plans to reduce emissions by 2035.

frases.estudio: Однако стоимость перехода и последствия для небольших предприятий ещё оцениваются.
frases.alumno: However, the cost of the transition and its effects on small businesses are still being assessed.

pregunta.texto: Which aspect is still under assessment?

opciones.texto: the cost and the effect on small businesses
opciones.explicacion: The second sentence presents both aspects as pending.

opciones.texto: the start date of the programme
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Программа предусматривает сокращение выбросов к 2035 году.»

frase.texto: Программа предусматривает сокращение выбросов к 2035 году.

opciones.texto: The programme plans to reduce emissions by 2035.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: However, the cost of the transition and its effects on small businesses are still being assessed.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Однако стоимость перехода и последствия для небольших предприятий ещё оцениваются

piezas.traduccion: However, the cost of the transition and its effects on small businesses are still being assessed.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
